semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company specializes in electric servo actuators that are used in automated manufacturing processes relevant to the semiconductor industry.
summary: Suzhou Jodell Robotics Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced electric servo actuators and automation solutions that enhance efficiency in semiconductor production. Their products, including intelligent electric grippers and high-throughput rotary linear actuators, are utilized by companies in the semiconductor sector among others.
capabilities: Electric servo actuators for automated manufacturing

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Suzhou, China, and has established itself as a leading enterprise in the robotics automation industry.
